items.title: Find your own pane
items.text: `ghoztty +list --tty=<tty>` returns the pane name for a given terminal device, so scripts and agents running inside a pane can identify themselves in a single command.

items.title: Polite input injection
items.text: `ghoztty +send-keys --when-idle` waits for the target pane to go idle (e.g. for Claude Code to finish generating) before typing, with a configurable `--idle-timeout`. No more keystrokes landing mid-output.
